data_scope: Same two already-observed development training assets in cloud-intake-protocol.json; reserved test asset remains unread
purpose: Add policy-relevant caller request observations before attempting a new classifier; never infer permission from attack labels or raw names
semantics: Caller-requested canned ACL/encryption settings only. Missing is unknown, not no encryption/private. A broad ACL can be legitimate and is not itself an independently labeled attack or authorization violation.
excluded: No raw bucket/object/role/account/IP identifiers as features; no arbitrary policy bodies, credentials, source labels or source partitions
